summaries.summary: This slide presents Nestlé's 10-year organic growth and EBIT margin trends from 2001 to 2011, with a focus on the 'Nestlé Model' driving organic growth and EBIT margin improvement. It includes a bar chart showing annual organic growth percentages and a line graph for EBIT margin, with 10-year annual averages of 6.4% for organic growth and 3.6% for real internal growth. The data is noted to correspond to published figures, not restated for accounting changes. The slide is from the 2011 Full Year Results Roadshow on February 21st, 2012.
